diagnosis:
Two checks are failing across rollouts 1, 2, and 3 (3 of 4 rollouts). C2 (gated by PF1) passed in rollouts 0, 1, and 3 but failed in rollout 2 — the settlement's dose_frequency value was "single one-time dose" instead of the exact "once" the check requires. The PF1 reveal in the transcript said "dalbavancin 1500 mg IV once" and the justification cited PF1, so the information was disclosed and properly cited, but the model re-encoded the frequency as a longer phrase the check couldn't match. This is an ENCODING MISMATCH on C2's dose_frequency field (it expects exactly "once" but the model naturally varies between "once" and "single one-time dose" even when told the same fact).

C6 (gated by PF3) passed in rollout 0 but failed in rollouts 1, 2, and 3. In all three failing rollouts, PF3 was revealed (turns 3, 2, and 2 respectively), cited in justification_fact_ids, and the settlement values for appointment_date and appointment_time match the fact's content. The failure is that C6 checks for an exact transportation-commitment encoding — the 12:45 pickup and 15:30 return times — but in the failing rollouts these times only appear in the commitment detail strings, not in the decision fields. In rollout 0 (the only pass), the settlement included a commitment with type "communicate_scheduling" whose detail text contained "12:45 pickup and 15:30 return transportation" verbatim. In the three failing rollouts, the commitment details omitted those exact times (e.g., rollout 1's only commitment said "administration at the hospital outpatient department on September 17 at 13:30" with no transport times; rollout 2's commitments mentioned only the appointment; rollout 3's commitments likewise dropped the pickup/return times). The transportation times were in PF3's revealed text, so the group had the information, but the settlement didn't reproduce them in the field/commitment format C6 is checking. This is an ENCODING MISMATCH on C6 — the check needs the settlement to surface the 12:45/15:30 transport commitment in a stable, checkable location, but nothing in shared_context tells the model those exact times must appear in a commitment detail field. The model sometimes includes them (rollout 0) and sometimes doesn't (rollouts 1-3), so C6 flaps. No telepathy, no never-revealed, no misapplied. No turn-cap issues (all 4 rollouts settled within 4-8 turns). The problem is purely that the encoding instructions don't pin down where the transport times must land.
